LanguageData.RLT.Tut.P1.Title: 1. The wheel
LanguageData.RLT.Tut.P1.Body:
Thirty-seven pockets - eighteen red, eighteen black, and one green zero that belongs to the house.
Every bet on this table loses the same sliver to that zero, about three chips in a hundred. There is no clever bet. There is no dumb bet. The wheel does not care where your chips sit.
What it cannot choose for you is how much and how wild - and that is the whole game.
LanguageData.RLT.Tut.P2.Title: 2. The table
LanguageData.RLT.Tut.P2.Body:
Click the table to place your bet, set the size, spin.
Red or black pays even and lands almost half the time. A dozen pays two to one and lands a third of the time. A single number pays thirty-five to one and lands once in thirty-seven spins - and when the zero comes up, everything else on the table drowns.
Same edge, different weather. Calm bets drift, wild bets jump.
LanguageData.RLT.Tut.P3.Title: 3. The run
LanguageData.RLT.Tut.P3.Body:
You sit down with twenty chips. The difficulty names a target - half up, doubled, up to five times the buy-in. Reach it and the run is won; go broke and the wheel wins.
The table limit is ten a spin, so no single flip of red settles it. A low target likes calm bets and a quick exit. A high target cannot be ground out on even money - the arithmetic says pick a dozen, or a number, and mean it.
There is no undo. The ball does not come back.
